text:
Alice M: Quick idea — can we try a shorter triage on Fridays? Thinking 25m instead of 40m to keep sprint wrap light. Agenda sketch below, want quick thumbs by EOD so I can update the calendar.

Ben K: Works for me. Fridays are usually lighter for me. :+1:

Carla R: I might be out half-day Fri next week, but good with shorter recurring slot. Do we still keep an owners roundup?

Alice M: Yes, still keep owners roundup but compact. Proposed agenda: 
```
1) 3m quick health (errors/alerts spikes)
2) 8m bug queue review (top 5 blockers)
3) 7m owner quick updates (who's blocking, who needs help)
4) 5m unblock actions + assign owners
5) 2m docs/async followups + close
```
(If more time needed, we spin an immediate follow-up with relevant owners.)

Devon S: Love the concise flow. Can we reserve 1 slot per month for RFC deep-dive? Otherwise we never get to design topics.

Alice M: Good call — suggest first Fri of month we add +20 for RFC. Keep standard 25m other weeks.

Ben K: Calendar note: if we cut to 25m, can we shift start time 15m earlier? That helps overlap with APAC folks for once a month.

Alice M: OK — propose recurring change: Fridays 9:15–9:40. First-of-month 9:15–9:55 for RFCs. Will ping infra to update invite.

Carla R: One more ask: can we add a pinned checklist in the channel so owners drop short pre-reads? e.g., 1-line ask + current blocker. Saves time.

InfraBot: Updated calendar invite: "Engineering Triage — compact" now set to Fridays, 2026-04-02 09:15 recurring. Notes: first Friday of month extended to 40m for RFCs. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/evt/triage-compact

Devon S: Thanks InfraBot. I'll add a template for owner pre-reads in the channel thread: 1) current status 2) blocker 3) desired help.

Ben K: fine by me. If attendance drops, we can do a quick pulse check after 3 runs.

Alice M: Great — I'll update the recurring invite and pin the checklist. Thanks all. :rocket:
